description: This file defines a documentation page for examples in a Keystone-based project. It imports components and utilities, fetches and transforms example data, and renders a layout with the examples data.

methods.name: getGroupedExamples
methods.description: Fetches all examples from the reader collection, transforms description nodes to Markdoc format, and filters examples by kind.
